info.title: Tonaris API
info.description: The /v1 contract shared by the web app, native clients and integrations. Changes within v1 are additive only.

get.summary: Check that the API is up

schema.description: The API is up.

get.summary: Get how many albums use each field
get.description: Every field of the account, with the albums applying it, active and in Trash, even empty. Settings shows it, and a used field's type can't change (FR-03.12, DS-60).

200.description: How many albums apply each of the account's fields (FR-03.12, DS-60).

inTrash.description: Albums in Trash applying the field.

schema.description: How many albums apply each of the account's fields (FR-03.12, DS-60).

get.summary: Get what deleting a field affects
get.description: The field with its options, the albums applying it, active and in Trash, and the scope hash that confirms deleting exactly that. `field.delete` always needs that hash, and refuses it if the field or the albums applying it changed meanwhile (FR-03.18, TS-14).

200.description: What deleting a field affects (FR-03.18, TS-14).

inTrash.description: Albums in Trash applying the field.

scopeHash.description: Confirms exactly this scope: pass it to `field.delete`. The deletion is refused if the field or the albums applying it changed meanwhile.

schema.description: What deleting a field affects (FR-03.18, TS-14).

get.summary: Get what removing an option affects
get.description: The albums choosing the option, active and in Trash, and the scope hash that confirms removing it from exactly them. `field.removeOption` needs that hash when any album chooses the option, and refuses it if the albums changed meanwhile (FR-03.17, TS-14).

200.description: What removing an option affects (FR-03.17, TS-14).

inTrash.description: Albums in Trash choosing the option.

scopeHash.description: Confirms exactly this scope: pass it to `field.removeOption`. The removal is refused if the albums choosing the option changed meanwhile.

schema.description: What removing an option affects (FR-03.17, TS-14).

get.description: Folders, lists and albums matching `q` by folder or list name, album title or artist credit, ignoring case and accents, with no typo tolerance (FR-12.4, FR-12.5). Each group is ordered as the app orders it: names that start with the query, then those with a word that does, then the rest. Trash isn't searched (FR-12.1).

schema.description: The text to find, matched as a substring ignoring case and accents.
At most this many results per group.

200.description: The caller's active folders, lists and albums matching the query by name, title or artist, ignoring case and accents, best first (FR-12, TS-50).

location.description: Where it is: the names from the top of the collection down to the folder or list holding it. Empty for the top level.

items.description: The best matches, at most `limit`.

get.summary: Get a folder's or list's sharing
get.description: For its owner: the pending and accepted invitations, the link that is on (the same URL each time), and access from folders above it (DS-65). `share.invite` and `share.setLink` change it, in the app only (X-03).

200.description: A folder's or list's sharing, for its owner (DS-65).

ownerDisplayName.description: The owner's display name; sharing needs one (FR-11.3).

email.description: The address as the owner typed it.

displayName.description: The person's display name, if they set one.

invitations.description: Pending and accepted invitations, oldest first.

link.description: The link that is on, if any; the same URL every time (TS-32).

inherited.description: Folders above that are shared, nearest first (FR-07.8).

schema.description: A folder's or list's sharing, for its owner (DS-65).

get.description: The signed-in person's pending invitations to view folders and lists, oldest first, leaving out those whose collection is in Trash (DS-66). `share.accept` and `share.decline` answer them, in the app (X-03).

items.description: An invitation to view a folder or list (FR-07.5).

get.description: For the page an invitation's email links to (DS-66): `pending` or `accepted` with the invitation for its recipient; `wrong_account`, with nothing about it, for anyone else while it is pending; otherwise `unavailable`.

invitation.description: An invitation to view a folder or list (FR-07.5).

get.description: The folders and lists the person keeps (FR-07.13): each with its owner's display name, whether an accepted invitation or a working link shares it, and whether it can be opened now. Names show only while it can.

name.description: The folder's or list's name while available; null once it isn't.

link.description: It was saved through a link that still works.

available.description: Whether it can be opened now (FR-07.13).

items.description: A folder or list in Shared with me (FR-07.13).

get.summary: Get whether a link is in Shared with me
get.description: For a signed-in visitor of a link's page (DS-68): whether its folder or list is in their Shared with me, and whether it is their own. Opening a link adds nothing; `share.saveLink` does.

schema.description: The link's token.

get.description: The folder or list a link shares, as its guests see it (FR-07.11, FR-07.12): its active folders and lists, their albums with links, and only the fields those albums use. No session is needed. An unknown, turned-off or suspended link is `404`, whatever the reason (DS-72).

schema.description: A mutation envelope (TS-20).

result.description: What the mutation reports. `membership.add` gives `{alreadyInList: boolean}`, true when the album was already in the list (FR-01.7); `album.capture` gives a `CaptureResult`; the others give null.

type.description: `about:blank`: the status and `code` carry the meaning.

base.description: The value the change assumed; absent when it created the record.

dependsOn.description: The `mutationId` of the first prerequisite not confirmed.

schema.description: A mutation's outcome (TS-27).

post.description: Runs up to 200 `BatchItem`s in order, each on its own, so a success stays whatever happens to later items (TS-25). An item runs only once every item it `dependsOn` is confirmed; otherwise it is `skipped`. Each item is validated and made idempotent by its `mutationId` as a single mutation is, so sending the batch again applies nothing twice. An `album.capture` item still running in another request answers the batch `409 in_progress`: the items before it stay saved, and sending the batch again replays them.

batchId.description: Made by the client; the answer carries it.

items.description: A `BatchItem` (`#/components/schemas/BatchItem`). Each item is validated on its own: one that isn't a valid `BatchItem` gets a `failed` outcome, and the others still run.
